admin/omafit.gap.body: Saving here stores the id in VTEX only. It does not create the shop in Omafit. Size charts, stylist flags and widget configuration are looked up by the shop domain above. There is no VTEX install endpoint in the Shopify or Nuvemshop backends. Try-on still runs when this public id belongs to an Omafit user with an active subscription.
